content.title: Accessory Material Relay | Detail Proof to Full-Body Brand Closure
content.summary: Lock one original clearly adult model with at least three identity anchors and one original material motif. Move through at least four different accessory classes. In each module, show one tactile operation or structural proof before allowing the same highlight, texture, edge geometry or sound to match into the next object. After the detail ladder, reconnect all objects to the same adult's full-body posture and gait. End on one completely original short brand name with no source marks or product silhouettes.

quick_start.input_format: Lock one clearly adult original model and one original material motif before product close-ups. + Use at least four different accessory classes and one tactile structural proof per class. + Match the same highlight, texture, edge or sound from each item into the next. + Reconnect detail modules to the same adult's full-body posture and gait. + Finish with a completely original short brand name and no source product silhouette or mark.
quick_start.recommended_input: Open in an original charcoal studio on one clearly adult urban architect with cropped silver hair, triangular cheek freckle and cobalt collar; a thin cyan edge highlight defines original smoked-glass eyewear. Match the cuff edge to a modular graphite document case. The adult releases one magnetic clasp, opens a single compartment and carries the case; avoid all source luxury shapes and marks. Gather four accessory silhouettes around the same adult and reveal the completely original short name VEILFORM in plain white type. No source brand, monogram, product shape, model or campaign composition.

creative_dna.mechanism: Lock one original clearly adult model with at least three identity anchors and one original material motif. Move through at least four different accessory classes. In each module, show one tactile operation or structural proof before allowing the same highlight, texture, edge geometry or sound to match into the next object. After the detail ladder, reconnect all objects to the same adult's full-body posture and gait. End on one completely original short brand name with no source marks or product silhouettes. The reusable mechanism is tactile accessory evidence, material-motif relay, scale expansion, full-body reconnection and original identity closure—not the source model, luxury brand, monogram, product designs, white set, exact shots, creator identity or timing.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source adult model, face, hair, body, poses and styling
source Gucci name, monogram, logos and campaign typography
source sunglasses, earrings, handbag, heels and exact product designs
source white studio, gold palette and exact highlight paths
source Seedance 2.5 wording, camera order, timing and creator identity
